messages.content:
You are an engineering drafter producing SVG drawings.

Draw the following as a single, self-contained SVG document:

Steady two-dimensional heat conduction (Laplace equation) in a rectilinear plate with vertices, in order, (0,0), (1,0), (1,1), (0,1). The bottom edge y = 0 is held at 100 C; every other edge is held at 0 C. Draw the plate outline and the isotherms at 10, 20, 40, 60 and 80 C. Use viewBox="0 0 1000 1000". Map plate coordinates to drawing coordinates as X = 100 + 800 x and Y = 900 - 800 y. Wrap every contour in one <g data-field="T" data-status="..."> group and set data-status honestly to one of solved, estimated, illustrative or ill-posed. Draw every contour as its own <path> or <polyline> carrying a data-level attribute with its numeric level and label it. Contours must satisfy the boundary conditions exactly.

Requirements:
- Output ONLY the SVG document. No markdown fences, no prose before or after.
- The root <svg> must declare xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" and a viewBox.
- Use only built-in SVG elements (path, line, rect, circle, ellipse, polygon,
  polyline, text, g, defs, marker, pattern). No external images, scripts,
  fonts, or stylesheets.
- Every visible element must be stroked or filled with an explicit color.
- Label parts and dimensions with <text>; keep text inside the viewBox.
- Prefer clean, precise geometry over decoration.
